events.title: Google Gemini 1.5 announced
events.summary: Google announced Gemini 1.5 on February 15, 2024 with a 1M-token context window and Mixture-of-Experts architecture.
events.about: Gemini 1.5 Pro's million-token context let developers pass entire codebases, books, or video in one prompt — a leap beyond 128K competitors. MoE architecture improved efficiency; the release kept Google competitive with GPT-4 Turbo and Claude 3.

narrative.whyChosen: Gemini 1.5's 1M context reset expectations for long-document AI workflows.
narrative.whyImportant: Million-token windows enabled whole-repo analysis without chunking hacks.
narrative.problemSolved: Large inputs had to be split and stitched, losing cross-document context.
